hook.es: ¿Por qué no puedo conformarme con una sola vida?
hook.en: Why can't I settle into just one life?

objective: Flashback to before Episode 1: The Traveler walks alone (NØVA does not exist yet) through fragments of his many past lives — infrastructure, cloud, construction, restaurants, sales, family, travel, business. Establish that his path looks scattered from outside but is one continuous search from inside.

scenes.description: The Traveler walks alone toward a row of translucent portal-worlds
scenes.visuals: A long stone path in the Parallel World, no companion beside him, eight faint translucent portals arranged ahead like doorways, each labeled
scenes.copy: Medellín. Después Providence. Entre las dos, demasiadas vidas.

scenes.visuals: The Traveler steps through a portal into a server-room-like glowing lattice — racks of light, terminal glyphs floating
scenes.copy: Administrador de sistemas. Consultor SOA. Cloud, DevOps, middleware. Aprendiendo que un sistema no falla por falta de tecnología — falla cuando está desconectado.

scenes.visuals: A second portal: scaffolding of light becoming a kitchen of light, The Traveler moving between both without pause
scenes.copy: Construcción. Restaurantes. Ejecución. Operación. Lecciones que ningún curso de tecnología enseña.

scenes.visuals: A quieter portal — warm light, a small home silhouette, a road stretching into distance

scenes.description: The Traveler stops between all the portals, none chosen
scenes.visuals: Wide shot: The Traveler standing at the center point where all eight portal-lights converge but don't merge, alone, mask dim
scenes.copy: ¿Por qué no puedo conformarme con una sola vida?
assets_needed: character sheet: the-traveler (doubt expression, flickering mask pattern)

scenes.description: Final beat — walking on, no answer yet
scenes.visuals: The Traveler turns and keeps walking past all the portals, none closing, all still glowing behind him
scenes.copy: Todavía no lo sabía. Pero cada una de esas vidas estaba dejando una pieza.

captions.es: ¿Cuál de todas tus vidas eres tú?
captions.en: Which of your lives are you?

metadata.thumbnail_concept: The Traveler alone, walking through overlapping translucent portal-worlds (infrastructure, cloud, construction site, restaurant kitchen, family) — no NØVA visible

notes: Act I of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md.

STRUCTURE NOTE: this episode is a flashback to before Episode 1. NØVA does not appear — The Traveler travels alone through this act (per canon: NØVA is born in Episode 1/Act II). Season viewing order is non-linear by design: Ep01 is a cold-open tease of NØVA's birth, Ep02 rewinds to the years before it.

Theme: dispersion vs. search — what looks like scattered career/life changes (Medellín roots, IT/SOA/cloud/DevOps freelance work, migration to the US/Providence, restaurants, construction, family) is one continuous search for purpose.
Emotional conflict: self-doubt about not fitting into one world; the central question of the whole season first appears here: "¿Estoy construyendo algo real, o simplemente saltando de idea en idea?"
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 02. Grounded in real biography — do not add invented employer names, dates, or figures beyond what's documented.
